cause.about: Why it is empty, which decides what it says and offers: first-use "No [things] yet" and Create; configure "Configure [feature]"; no-results "No results found" and nothing louder than Clear filters; cl

title.about: About five words, no full stop. Never "No data".

headingLevel.about: Its place in the page's outline. Default 2.

description.about: Full sentences: what happened and what to do, without blaming anyone.

action.ts: { label: string; href?: string; onClick?: () => void; }
action.about: The one thing to do next. A link when it goes somewhere, a button when it acts.

secondary.ts: { label: string; href?: string; onClick?: () => void; }
secondary.about: A quieter way on: a link to read more, or Clear filters.

icon.about: The cause's mark by default; false for words alone.

media.about: A picture in place of the mark (a Plate): decorative, never the message.

size.about: compact: one sentence, for a card or a sidebar. section (default), or page for a whole page.

reference.about: An error's code, after the description, for support: never in the title.

pairWith.EmptyState.Show mark: icon or media (omit both to hide)
